verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own corporations pages list online filing paths for core transactions: registering a foreign LLC online, closing a corporation online, and an Express Annual Report, alongside the Start a Domestic Business entry point. The evidence is mostly navigation-link titles rather than walkthrough documentation. Department of Revenue licensing pages belong to a different agency and are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that domestic formation itself can be completed online, detailed first-party documentation of the online filing and payment flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
